title: Hausdorff integrals over a rotated Lipschitz graph
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, q a linear isometry equivalence of R^{n+l}, D a measurable subset of R^n, L >= 0, and f : R^n -> R^l L-Lipschitz on D. Put F(x') := q(graphPoint(x', f(x'))), so that q '' graphOver f D = F(D). Then for every measurable g : R^{n+l} -> [0, infinity], the integral of g over q '' graphOver f D with respect to H^n = μHE[n] is at most (1 + L^2)^{n/2} = sqrt(1 + L^2)^n times the Lebesgue integral of g(F(x')) over x' in D.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (D : Set (Rn n)) (L : ℝ≥0), MeasurableSet D → LipschitzOnWith L f D → ∀ g : Amb n ℓ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → ∫⁻ x in q '' graphOver f D, g x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (1 + (L : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ n) * ∫⁻ x' in D, g (q (graphPoint x' (f x')))
